pass_requires: current version save/load preserves canonical DemoState, room and player pose
older and unknown versions fail closed before state restoration
corrupt JSON and wrong schema fail closed
incompatible canonical state payload fails without mutating live state
SAVE%d.dat filename pattern and slot names are unchanged
rejections emit diagnostics without claiming migration support
evidence_boundary: This gate proves compatibility policy and fail-closed behavior for the current v145 save format. It does not claim migration support for historical or future save versions.
